text:
sarah: FYI customer OnboardX was billed both a monthly platform_fee and a private-deploy onboarding fee in April. Invoice link: https://invoices.internal/INV-6022. Can someone check whether we should credit the overlap? cc @clare @anita

anita: I checked event logs. OnboardX completed Private deploy on 2026-04-10. Their billing period is 04/01 - 04/30, and onboarding add-on was charged with a 04/10 effective date. That gives ~20 days of concurrent charge.

clare: Sales flagged that onboarding should be billed as a one-time onboarding fee but not double-charge for the month they migrate. There was a negotiation note from 2026-03-25 offering a "migration month pro-rate" for customers moving mid-cycle.

mike: Invoice detail: 
```
platform_fee   900.00   04/01 - 04/30
onboard_addon  900.00   onboarding 04/10
```
If we follow the pro-rate, credit = (21/30)*900 = $630.00. Need approval and GL code. @luke?

luke: I approve a one-time credit for this case. Use GL 4-102-OnboardCredits. Add audit memo: "onboarding overlap credit - OnboardX".

sarah: Should this be applied as a credit memo against INV-6022 or issued as a refund? Prefer credit memo.

mike: Will create credit memo and apply. Creating adjustment now. Calculator: 21 days/30 days * 900 = 630.00 (rounded).

billing-bot: Adjustment created: ADJ-10007 amount: -630.00 status: pending approval.

raj: Legal: confirm we have the negotiation note in SFDC or email to support pro-rate. We need written authorization for audit trail.

clare: I have the March 25 sales negotiation note in SFDC and an email from the account exec dated 2026-03-26 confirming the pro-rate. I'll attach both to the credit memo.

elaine: FYI ops: when you post the credit, tag product: "private-billing" so we can capture this in the migration billing experiment metrics. We want to track how often we apply these credits.

mike: ADJ-10007 issued and applied to INV-6022. Amount: $630.00 credit. GL posted to 4-102-OnboardCredits. Links: https://billing.internal/adj/ADJ-10007. Attached SFDC note and sales email. No cash refund.

sarah: Thanks all. I'll update April reconciliation and add to the billing experiment dashboard. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
